segments.sn22.33:1.3: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn22.33:1.5: Rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, na tumhākaṃ, taṃ pajahatha.
segments.sn22.33:1.6: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn22.33:1.8: Sā vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn22.33:1.11: Te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti.
segments.sn22.33:1.13: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati”.
segments.sn22.33:2.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, yaṃ imasmiṃ jetavane tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ taṃ jano hareyya vā ḍaheyya vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā kareyya.
segments.sn22.33:2.3: ‘amhe jano harati vā ḍahati vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā karotī’”ti?
segments.sn22.33:2.6: “Na hi no etaṃ, bhante, attā vā attaniyaṃ vā”ti.
segments.sn22.33:2.7: “Evameva kho, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ na tumhākaṃ, taṃ pajahatha.
segments.sn22.33:2.8: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn22.33:2.10: Sā vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn22.33:2.14: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissatī”ti.

lines: Dabbādi pākatikatiṇaṃ pākaṭamevāti apākaṭaṃ dassetuṃ tālanāḷikerādi dassitaṃ, tiṇakaṭṭhānaṃ vā bhedadassanatthaṃ.
